statuses.playable: A person played it and confirmed gameplay.
statuses.title: Reached its title, login or main menu on screen; gameplay is not confirmed.
statuses.runs: Starts and runs a bounded session to its window and surface without a fatal error; no screen or gameplay confirmation is recorded.
statuses.blocked: Starts, then the app itself ends the session; the cause is outside the emulator's framework services.

com.tiltingpoint.spongebob.name: SpongeBob: Krusty Cook-Off
com.tiltingpoint.spongebob.evidence: The maintainer plays and completes cooking levels, reaching level 16 at about 60 FPS, and uses Settings and Help Center; screenshots in the app page.
notes: Choose the child-age path in the game: the adult-age path needs Google Play services (microG) and stalled at 73%; it was not retested on this build.
Rewarded ads do not complete (Kidoz ad stays on its loading screen).

com.YoStarEN.AzurLane.name: Azur Lane
com.YoStarEN.AzurLane.evidence: The maintainer reports it is playable online, with audio and pause/resume working, through a finished battle. A screenshot shows the home screen at 60 FPS (Docs/Apps/azur-lane.md).
notes: UI delays at the login scene were reported on 2026-10-14 and have not been re-checked.

com.mobge.Oddmar.name: Oddmar
com.mobge.Oddmar.evidence: The maintainer reports it gets past the black screen after its splash video; a 75 s session reached its next video without an abort. Gameplay is not confirmed.
notes: Needs media.extractor, POSIX timers and the Java Binder attach preload.

com.ubisoft.hungrysharkworld.name: Hungry Shark World
com.ubisoft.hungrysharkworld.evidence: A 358 s session with ads and taps on the game's links, run by hand (Docs/TESTS.md); gameplay is not confirmed.
notes: Rewarded video ads had no fill from Google Mobile Ads before the ad-SDK gaps were closed; not re-checked.
Play Games sign-in does not complete: after the Google window, Google answers games/v1/players/me with HTTP 404 and microG reports SIGN_IN_REQUIRED (2026-10-21).

com.fgol.HungrySharkEvolution.name: Hungry Shark Evolution
com.fgol.HungrySharkEvolution.evidence: A 180 s session reached its window, surface and popups without framework-service exceptions (Docs/TESTS.md); gameplay is not confirmed.

com.roblox.client.name: Roblox
com.roblox.client.evidence: Logs in and joins live servers; about 170 s later the server disconnects it with reason 304. The client's Play Integrity token request fails; that this causes the kick is inferred, not proven.
notes: Needs real Google attestation; Bifrost does not bypass or forge it.

com.bilibili.trickcal.name: TrickCal
com.bilibili.trickcal.evidence: Crashes about 17 s in from the game's own anti-cheat native code, as on real Linux; it also fails when connecting on Waydroid.

jp.co.ponos.battlecatsen.name: The Battle Cats
jp.co.ponos.battlecatsen.evidence: The maintainer reports it is playable; no screenshots or session details are recorded. The version is the installed package's.
notes: On 2026-10-21 the first ad load blocked the main thread for about 7 s waiting on the Play services Dynamite provider; not re-checked.

com.uptodown.name: Uptodown
com.uptodown.evidence: Reaches its main window and draws the Trending list; it then shows its own 'storage permission is required' dialog. Before NsdManager was published it ended in onActivityCreated. Interaction was not tried.
notes: The dialog's Accept asks for all-files access through a Settings screen that does not exist; the request is declined.

jp.co.cygames.umamusume.name: Umamusume Pretty Derby (JP)
jp.co.cygames.umamusume.evidence: The maintainer reports the game stops at a device integrity check when it connects to its servers. It reaches its Unity window and surface first.
notes: Needs a device that passes the game's integrity check; Bifrost does not bypass or forge it.
On 2026-10-21 Play Games sign-in did not complete: microG's GamesSignInActivity returned 'response=none'.

com.cygames.umamusume.name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby (Global)
com.cygames.umamusume.evidence: The maintainer reports it is playable. Screenshots show the title, home and Career story screens at 30 FPS; no race or training capture.

com.kiloo.subwaysurf.name: Subway Surfers
com.kiloo.subwaysurf.evidence: The maintainer reports it is playable and its ads work (APKPure 3.70.3 build); no screenshots or further detail are recorded.

com.robtopx.geometryjumplite.name: Geometry Dash Lite
com.robtopx.geometryjumplite.evidence: The maintainer reports it is playable; no screenshots or session details are recorded.
notes: Ads are only somewhat stable in the maintainer's report; which ads fail, and how, is not recorded.

org.mozilla.firefox.name: Firefox
org.mozilla.firefox.evidence: Sessions reach the main Activity, a GPU window, first-run onboarding and a GeckoView surface, with tab, GPU and crash-helper child processes. The maintainer reports pages do not load.
notes: Most sessions end when a native Gecko thread reaches an in-process Java Binder service without a JVM attachment (JavaBinder: env null); which service is not identified.
The first codec query blocks Gecko's main thread for 5 s waiting for media.player, which is not published, delaying the tab process by about 9 s.
Firefox sends its own telemetry and, when accepted in its dialog, crash reports to Mozilla.

com.google.android.youtube.name: YouTube
com.google.android.youtube.evidence: The maintainer's screenshot shows the home screen (logo, search bar and the Home, Shorts, Subscriptions and You tabs). Later sessions that day searched and played video while its frame conversion was profiled. The maintainer has not reported it as playable.
notes: Shorts in a landscape window and the signed-in feed are not confirmed.
